description: Budget of the measured health gate (scripts/checkHealth.mjs): the Fallow health findings of the source at sourceRevision, scored with that source's own complete c8 coverage. The checker never writes it; retake it only as AGENTS.md describes.

droppedFixedFindings.reason: sourceLink's checks moved into small helpers (citedSourceOf, requireLineRange, requireExactQuote), so its critical complexity and critical CRAP findings are fixed; validatePages and renderWikiPages keep theirs. The functions this cycle added stay under the limits.

The retake for Fallow 3.46.0 on e513fa74 finds one moderate CRAP finding of extension.ts fewer than the baseline taken on b8430743: Cycles 0144 and 0145 split and covered the Devin setup code, so that finding is fixed and dropped. The baseline gains one refactoring target, src/server.ts:complexity, which gates nothing and stays a paydown candidate.

The retake for Fallow 3.47.0 on ae225748 finds one high complexity finding of extension.ts fewer than the baseline taken on e513fa74, and its high CRAP finding is now moderate: Cycles 0147 and 0148 changed and covered that file's code, so the high complexity finding is fixed and dropped. The same coverage scored with Fallow 3.46.0 gives the same 209 entries, so the drop comes from the source, not from the Fallow update. The 37 refactoring targets are unchanged.
